message: resolver = "pure-python" is the older name of resolver_backend: Pipenv reads resolver_backend first, but pipenv update, pipenv upgrade and pipenv uninstall of Pipenv before 2026.9.1 read only resolver, so there it still selects a resolver backend that locks without cool-down-period
fix: Remove resolver from [pipenv] in Pipfile, and write resolver_backend = "pip" if the backend must be named, so that Pipenv locks with pip and applies cool-down-period
